name: 130. Anthropic per-message effort override (mid-conversation output_config) forwarded on /anthropic/v1/messages (per-message-effort)
description:
Pi 0.87.1 with supportsMidConvoEffort sends a top-level output_config.effort ("high") and overrides it for the current turn with an effort-only mid-conversation system message: {"role":"system","content":[],"output_config":{"effort":"low"}} under beta mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01. Bifrost's AnthropicMessage (core/providers/anthropic/types.go) kept only role and content, so on the normalized /anthropic/v1/messages path (any non-Claude-Code user agent) the override was dropped on ingress (no content blocks -> no neutral item) and the upstream request ran at the top-level effort; changing effort between turns was silently ignored and the beta header was never derived.

The fix carries the per-message output_config on AnthropicMessage and on the neutral ResponsesMessage, re-emits it as an effort-only role:"system" message (empty content array, placement-exempt) when the provider+model supports per-turn effort (Anthropic direct: Opus 5+, Sonnet 5.5, Fable/Mythos), injects mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01 from the body on both the typed and raw-body paths, and drops the item fail-soft elsewhere (unsupported Claude models, and the OpenAI-shaped egress, which has no equivalent and rejects an empty-content system item).

Cases: (1) anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 non-streaming with x-bf-send-back-raw-request -> 200 with text AND the echoed raw_request carries exactly one role:system message with content [] and output_config.effort low while the top-level effort stays high (pre-fix: the override is absent from raw_request); (2) the same request streaming (Pi's actual shape) -> 200 SSE with content_block_delta and message_stop, no error event; (3) anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 (mid-conversation system supported, per-turn effort not) -> 200 and raw_request carries no system message, pinning the fail-soft drop instead of a forwarded 400.

Vertex rows (Claude Code raw passthrough): Claude Code 2.1.285 also sends output_config on a text-bearing role:"system" message. Vertex rejects it with "messages.1.output_config: Extra inputs are not permitted" (seen in production on Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5.5). StripUnsupportedFieldsFromRawBody and the typed stripUnsupportedAnthropicFields now remove messages[].output_config wherever per-message effort is unsupported, keep the system text and top-level effort, and drop effort-only system items whole. Red pre-fix (400), green post-fix (200).

item.name: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 /anthropic/v1/messages per-message effort override (system content [] + output_config.effort low) reaches the provider - per-message-effort

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null);
// Pi 0.87.1 (supportsMidConvoEffort) sends a top-level output_config.effort plus an effort-only
// role:"system" message ({content: [], output_config: {effort: low}}) overriding it for the current
// turn, under beta mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01. Pre-fix AnthropicMessage kept only
// role and content, so the override was dropped and the upstream request ran at the top-level effort.
pm.test('anthropic claude-opus-5-5 per-message effort override request is accepted (200 with text)', function () {

pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'want 200; a 400 means the override reached Anthropic malformed or the beta header was not injected, and any other status is a real failure: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
var hasText = Array.isArray(body.content) && body.content.some(function (b) { return b.type === 'text' && b.text; });
pm.expect(hasText, 'expected a text content block: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.true;
pm.test('anthropic claude-opus-5-5 per-message effort: the effort-only system message reaches the provider with effort low', function () {
if (pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-type') === 'passthrough') {
// Native Messages passthrough forwards the caller's body as sent and returns Anthropic's own
// bytes, so there is no raw_request; anthropicmsg and the route tests cover those bytes offline.
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-provider'), 'native passthrough answered by another provider: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.eql('anthropic');
return;
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.output_config && rr.output_config.effort, 'top-level output_config.effort must stay high: ' + wire.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('high');
var msgs = Array.isArray(rr.messages) ? rr.messages : [];
var overrides = msgs.filter(function (m) { return m && m.role === 'system' && m.output_config && m.output_config.effort === 'low'; });
pm.expect(overrides.length, 'per-message output_config.effort=low was dropped before the provider (pre-fix: AnthropicMessage kept only role+content): ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(Array.isArray(overrides[0].content) && overrides[0].content.length === 0, 'effort-only system message must carry an empty content array: ' + JSON.stringify(overrides[0])).to.be.true;
